findings.reason: The original standalone PNG at original resolution visibly prints K^n in the title. The caret is an exponent operation, as confirmed by the body field-space notation, rather than an ordinary name or Lp-style abbreviation. The title lacks delimiters required to render that exponent.
findings.action: Wrap existing K^n in inline math delimiters without changing the notation.

source_lines_after.4: title: 'Explicit comparison constants for the standard norms on $K^n$'

native_visual.inspection: Standalone original-resolution PNG inspected: title renders K with superscript n; full body visible and unchanged.
native_visual.limitations: Local native title/ItemBody preview, not production-route coverage; 16 unrelated reference-map parse diagnostics reported.

intermediate_work_note: An intermediate replacement mishandled the JavaScript replacement-string dollar syntax, producing an invalid title and duplicated suffix. Rendercheck caught the title failure. The item was reconstructed exactly from the frozen preimage with callback-based title replacement; all final checks and fa033-final preview bind only the corrected one-line diff. Earlier previews/fa033 is superseded and is not final evidence.
